problem: expert collapse leading to gradient spike and NaN loss
root_cause: auxiliary loss coefficient too low combined with no gradient clipping, allowing a collapsed top-1 routing distribution (few experts absorbing most tokens) to produce a gradient spike that overflows into NaN
fix: increase the auxiliary load-balancing loss coefficient to rebalance routing and add gradient clipping to bound the spike
key_evidence: 3 of 32 experts receiving over 80 percent of routed tokens
gradient norm spiked sharply in the 50 steps preceding the NaN
